verdict.rationale: Jan is a desktop app positioned as an open-source ChatGPT replacement. It downloads and runs local LLMs and has an in-app chat with conversations, projects, and inline tool-approval panels, so the built-in graphical chat with local models is clearly delivered. missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the chat interface itself (e.g. message, thread and model-switching UI walkthrough), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a brief community mention.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Jan is an open-source replacement for Claude and ChatGPT. It comes with built-in foundation models and an application ecosystem that runs entirely on your hardware
Download and run LLMs (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss etc.) from HuggingFace
Approval panels appear inline inside the tool card in the chat, showing the exact arguments the model wants to pass before you accept or deny.
you can assign an assistant to it so every conversation in that project automatically uses your chosen persona and instructions.
